summary: features.mjs gains lanes (openable milestones + run/<run>/<dep> base tags from meta.env), deps, next <m> (lane-local after rule) and pass; scope_owns takes an optional <m>- role prefix; config.sh and the user template carry the six lane defaults; the driver header documents HARNESS_LANE_POLL. New tests/checks/35-lanes-scheduler.sh (12 checks). Nothing calls them yet.
verified_how: 35-lanes-scheduler: 12 checks watched red (0/10, then the config and no-cycle checks red alone) then green; full suite 406/406 before the review fixes (209 s, 4 jobs) and 407/407 after (208 s); node --check features.mjs, bash -n on every shell file touched; an Opus review of the diff (1 Important, fixed with a check; 4 Minor: 1 fixed, 3 below as discoveries).

discoveries.text: F lanes counts only EARLIER lanes as dependencies: an after into a later milestone's name is nothing (as deps() reads it), and into a later milestone's feature id leaves that feature waiting inside its lane, so M1 can run out of work while M2 waits on verified-M1. A lint rule for forward cross-milestone after (proposed) would catch it at the initializer.

scope_owns' spec regex ([A-Za-z0-9_]+-)? has no . or -: P1-04 must build lane units with the milestone reduced (${m//[^A-Za-z0-9_]/_}), or a milestone like M1.5 or T-1 gives units gc never stops and status never lists.

With the <m>- prefix, run demo's scope_owns also matches run demo-x's harness-demo-x-svc: gc keeps it (a live owner keeps the unit; the 08/13 comment now says so), but harness status for demo (bin/harness:268) would list demo-x's units too.
Lane id 'default' is features without a milestone; a milestone literally named default would merge with them. Nothing reserves the name yet.
F lanes reads the run id from <state>/meta.env's RUN_ID (else the state dir's name) for its run/<run>/<dep> tags; F next/blocked take an optional 5th arg <m> (blocked too), unchanged without it.

proposed_changes: P1-02 step 1: 'has a feature left to try' should read 'has a feature left to try or every feature passes' (plan §9: a complete unverified milestone must open to be verified); built and checked that way
a lint rule forward-after: a feature whose after names a feature of a later milestone (lanes can't run it)
